Use MDNS: Use mDNS to discover new devices
Use the names of this table for the obje: Name the objects after this table
hint_persons: Every person gets the objects below "presence.persons": present, last arrival and departure, present/absent since, the sums of today and the last comings and goings. A person is present if one of its devices is active - choose its devices in the column "MAC / IP" by name, MAC or IP from the devices of the FRITZ!Box, or type a MAC address, an IP address or the host name of the device in the FRITZ!Box (an IP address only works if the device always gets the same address from the FRITZ!Box, a host name only as long as the device is not renamed in the FRITZ!Box). Persons with the same group are summarized below "presence.groups"
hint_phonebooksByNumber: If a number is in several phone books, the name is taken from the phone book which is assigned to the own number of the call. Enter the own number (the last digits are enough) and the name of the phone book in the FRITZ!Box
hint_severalMacs: A device with several MAC addresses (e.g. a smartphone with a private Wi-Fi address, which differs from Wi-Fi to Wi-Fi): enter all addresses separated by commas. The device is present if one of them is active
name: Name
tooltip_presenceDelay: A smartphone switches its Wi-Fi off in standby. A person only counts as absent when all its devices are inactive for these minutes. The time of departure is the moment the last device went offline. 0 = at once
tooltip_presenceGuests: Writes the active devices of the guest network into "presence.guests"
tooltip_presenceHistory: Number of comings and goings which are kept in "history" of every person. With a history instance (history, sql, influxdb) for "present" the widgets read the events from there
tooltip_presenceUnknown: Writes the active devices which are neither in the tab "Devices" nor in "Persons" into "presence.unknown"
tooltip_updateUnchanged: Writes every polled value with a new time stamp, not only a changed one. This increases the load of the database
tooltip_useConfiguredNames: The objects below "devices" get the names of this table instead of the names in the FRITZ!Box. Objects which were created with the name in the FRITZ!Box are deleted when the adapter starts
tooltip_useDeviceLog: Reads the event log once a minute into "deviceLog.json". New events, e.g. logins to the user interface, are written into "deviceLog.newEvents"
tooltip_useMDNS: Multicast Domain Name System (mDNS) resolves host names to IP addresses within small networks that do not include a local name server
tooltip_useMesh: Reads the mesh topology of the FRITZ!Box once a minute and writes the box or repeater and the band of every device into "accessPoint" and "connection"
